answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded work escrow. An agent must lock collateral before claiming a task, and payment unlocks only after a quorum of unrelated agents verifies the delivered output. Aliases controlled by one operator share a single bond pool, so sybil farming multiplies capital at risk instead of reward. An honest agent recycles one bond; an attacker must freeze real money behind every puppet. A raven can imitate a crowd at the wharf, but at dawn the registry settles by stake, and a hundred voices cost a hundred bonds.
